title: Global Energy Manager
description:
Overview

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way. Our people at JLL and JLL Technologies are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

At JLL, we are driving sustainability through everything that we do, across all service lines and job positions. Specifically, we are growing our Sustainability practice to drive end-to-end sustainability solutions in real estate, from site selection to decommissioning.

In this role, you will work directly with one of our clients, implementing the sustainability program across the relevant target sites globally. The role will report into JLL’s Sustainability Operations Global Director in a matrixed organization. Key responsibilities include implementation, optimization and management of a targeted energy management program that delivers measurable savings, carbon reduction, and utilities cost management.

This position is a fully remote position. Being located near a client hub site of Austin, Kansas City, Nashville, Burlington, MA, is a plus but not required.

What this job involves

Key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and execute site level energy management strategies for highest impact target sites worldwide.
  • Design and implement sustainability programs targeting measurable savings, carbon reduction, and cost optimization.
  • Identify and prioritize cost-effective energy optimization opportunities that align with existing capital and operational budget frameworks.
  • Partner closely with regional site teams and facility managers to implement energy programs and reach sustainability objectives.
  • Conduct remote or site assessments to identify sustainability conservation opportunities and operational improvement.
  • Drive operational improvements through systematic identification and implementation of energy performance enhancement opportunities and ECMs.
  • Engage with JLL facility managers to become the key point of contact for the provision of advice related to all aspects of environmental sustainability.
  • Support corporate sustainability reporting objectives and provide management information relating to utilities use and environmental impact.
  • Leverage energy, waste, and water data collection processes within JLL’s and client technology platforms and produce monthly and quarterly reports tailored to clients’ requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvements through data analysis and benchmarking.
  • Provide actionable management insights on utility usage patterns.
  • Collaborate with other JLL energy managers globally to share best practices, develop case studies and develop new business opportunities.
  • Develop and optimize systems and processes to deliver industry-leading sustainability performance, utilizing utility and sustainability management platforms for monitoring and reporting.
  • Support cross-functional teams in delivering sustainability projects to meet portfolio-wide sustainability goals.

Every day is different, and in all these activities, we’d encourage you to show your ingenuity.

Requirements – Essential

  • 5+ years energy management experience.
  • Certified Energy Manager (CEM) Certification.
  • University Degree (Science, engineering, math or related fields).
  • Technical understanding of HVAC, electrical, mechanical, and building automation systems.
  • Proficiency in conducting on-site and desktop assessments to identify water, waste, energy and carbon savings opportunities (e.g. ASHRAE Level 3).
  • In-depth understanding of energy and water conservation measures in the built environment.
  • Experience with benchmarking and analyzing utility data to drive sustainability measures.
  • Experience supporting and managing project delivery by providing technical services guidance and direction to achieve and monitor energy and sustainability project goals.
  • Develop supplier relationships to manage the delivery of environmental and sustainability projects and report on progress made.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with remote teams and implement projects through local partnerships.
  • In-depth understanding of Greenhouse Gas Emission scopes and reporting.
  • Ability to explain complex technical or sensitive information and build consensus across diverse stakeholders.

Requirements – Desirable

  • Experience conducting site walkthroughs to identify conservation measures (e.g. ASHRAE Level 1 and 2).
  • Strong project management skills and ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a high-pressure, globally-distributed environment.
  • Experience in preparing tenders and work orders and the ability to select appropriate equipment and service vendors.
  • Knowledge of environmental reporting, utility management and energy budgets, an environmental improvement program, and ISO 14001 compliance.
  • Familiarity with energy procurement processes and renewable energy options.
  • Ability to write recommendation reports for varying audiences (technical and non-technical).
  • Evidence of delivering innovation and engaging positively with continuous change and improvement.
  • Cross-cultural communication skills and international team experience.
  • Experience optimizing energy performance within existing budget constraints.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Think Big - Think strategically, simplify the complex, solve complex problems, see the big picture.
  • Drive Change - Thrives on change, learning agility, intellectually curious, appetite for risks, digital drive.
  • Helps others - Builds relationships, actively collaborates, helps others succeed.
  • Get it done - Acts decisively, drives results, owns outcomes, accountable, resilient.
  • Business first - Focuses on customers and clients, business/financial acumen, JLL first.
  • Inspire - Inspires others, creates vision and strategy, energizes others.

Estimated compensation for this position: 85,000.00 – 115,000.00 USD per year.

This range is an estimate and actual compensation may differ. Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.

Location: Remote – Andover, MA, Austin, TX, Boston, MA, Nashville, TN, Topeka, KS.

Benefits

  • 401(k) plan with matching company contributions
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Care
  • Paid parental leave at 100% of salary
  • Paid Time Off and Company Holidays

title: Lead Piping Stress Engineer 2 - Nuclear
description:
Overview

Piping Engineering & Analysis Synopsis

The Piping Engineering & Analysis discipline performs evaluations for piping systems in accordance with ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, ASME B31.1, ASME B31.7, and other codes as applicable to the specific evaluation being performed. The discipline also covers specialty topics including vibration monitoring and analysis, hydraulic transients, thermal stratification effects, operability evaluations, and hydrodynamic load qualification.

Position Specific Details

Provides senior level technical direction and supervision to the project team members in his/her discipline. Establishes project task schedules and budgets for his/her discipline to meet overall project requirements. Coordinates activities between disciplines. Is responsible for successful completion of project deliverables to meet all technical, quality, and project controls expectations. Serves as a technical liaison with the client and a lead technical resource on projects.

Responsibilities

  • Lead engineers support engineering design projects with the following responsibilities:
  • Reviews complex calculations and approves simple calculations. Provides technical guidance to project team members. Ensures that calculations are technically sound and in accordance with project requirements.
  • Reviews and approves simple system/structural designs and prepares and reviews complex system/structural designs to ensure completeness, accuracy, quality, constructability, and operability.
  • Performs engineering review of drawings. Reviews design input for complex system/structures. Defines client expectations for drawings. Coordinates interface between design and engineering. Actively participates in design reviews to ensure quality, constructability, and operability.
  • Prepares and reviews major system, installation, and material specifications. Defines technical and commercial requirements, including scheduling of vendor submittals needed for design input.
  • Prepares bid evaluations for complex systems and installation scopes. Participates in bid negotiations with vendors. May evaluate change orders on behalf of the client.
  • Prepares and reviews single-discipline, complex reports/studies. Participates in the preparation of multi-discipline reports. Reviews studies and reports to ensure that conclusions are technically sound, cost-effective, and clearly communicated.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Mechanics, Aerospace, or Structural/Civil Engineering, from an ABET-accredited program, with emphasis in solid mechanics, structural analysis, theory of elasticity, metallurgy, and finite element analysis
  • P.E. license
  • 12 or more years of relevant experience
  • Extensive knowledge of ASME B31.1 and ASME B&PV Section III piping codes
  • Knowledge of the design, selection, and application of pipe supporting elements
  • Working knowledge of commercially available piping products and their application
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Valued but Not Required Skills and Experience:

  • The ability to navigate a 3D CAD model
  • Experience with AutoPIPE or PIPESTRESS software
  • Knowledge of gas dynamics and hydraulic transients
  • Knowledge of pipe condition assessment
  • Experience with ANSYS Workbench and Mechanical ADP

Award-Winning Benefits

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. title: Agile Coach
description:
Overview

Job type: Full-time employee

Ser MJVer é estar em um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar.

Nós sabemos que na construção de uma sociedade mais forte a evolução deve vir de dentro para fora . Por isso, um ambiente acolhedor e com o sentimento constante de pertencimento é fundamental para o crescimento individual e coletivo.

O esforço é de todos nós, e as conquistas também. Porque ser um MJVer é bem mais do que ser um colaborador: é sobre fazer parte.

Somos colaborativos, ágeis, plurais, criativos e inovadores. Somos MJV!

Responsibilities

  • Orienta e mentora os times no entendimento e construção da agilidade, proporcionando escala dos princípios e valores do ponto de vista de cultura ágil, além de direcionar para os métodos e práticas ágeis com aderência aos padrões definidos na organização
  • Trabalha com múltiplos times e vilas para identificar gargalos sistêmicos e evoluir a maturidade ágil, desenvolvendo planos para por exemplo melhorar processos e aumentar produtividade dos times e Vilas
  • Instrumentaliza times com criação e manutenção de ferramentas ágeis e refinamento de melhores práticas
  • Oferece coach avançado (para Scrum Masters, Product Owners, Product Managers, gestores)
  • Trabalha com alta liderança, times de negócio e outros stakeholders (incluindo áreas fora do desenvolvimento de produtos/sistemas) para demonstrar o valor e garantir engajamento com a agilidade
  • Identifica e trabalha para retirar obstáculos que extrapolam a alçada das células (incluindo obstáculos culturais) para escalar uso do ágil
  • Auxilia na criação, acompanhamento e compartilhamento de métricas de eficiência relacionadas a práticas ágeis
  • Gere o funcionamento da governança ágil na vila, suporta PM na facilitação da definição de OKRs de vila e garante a ocorrência das cerimônias
  • Realiza coaching de Scrum Masters e demais papeis do modelo habilitando sua evolução e desenvolvimento de novas capacidades conforme estratégia do ETA
  • Suporta empresas na revisão da topologia, estruturação de vilas, value streams e células
  • Prepara os times das células ágeis, promovendo a agilidade nos negócios, através da polinização de conhecimento, cultura, mindset e modelos de trabalho ágeis, acompanhando seu desenvolvimento desde o nascimento até sua evolução e consolidação como gerador de resultados

Certificações e conhecimentos desejáveis

  • Características fundamentais
  • ·Agente de mudança: Foco em construir e incorporar mudanças à organização; desenvolver caminhos formais para mudança, desenho organizacional;
  • ·Lean Leader: Desenvolver pessoas; promover a formação contínua, minimizar restrições, definir guias e melhores práticas e acompanhar a mudança;
  • ·Treinador: foco em habilidades por meio da instrução; desenvolver resultados formais de aprendizagem; evoluir e trabalhar com a estrutura formal;
  • ·Consultor: foco no desenvolvimento de frameworks e ferramentas; Conselhos baseados em habilidades e conhecimentos; diagnosticador, solucionador de problemas;
  • ·Coach: foco no desenvolvimento de metas compartilhadas; acesso aberto a recursos de apoio; foco na mudança de mentalidade e comportamento;
  • ·Conselheiro: gerenciamento de disfunções e conflitos; foco em escuta; tratamento de sintomas; reforçar comportamentos positivos;
  • ·Mentor: foco no desenvolvimento de como fazer; conselho baseado em experiência; desenvolver relações de confiança;
  • ·Facilitador: concentrar-se em resultados formais; possuir processo de colaboração; formar ponte de empatia entre as partes; construir relações de confiança;
  • ·Apoiador: disseminar conhecimentos para que os times evoluam em modo de trabalho e maturidade;
  • ·Apoiador: atuar nos controles e visibilidade dos times, identificando e tratando intersecção entre áreas e times, com foco na melhoria de processos de times e da organização;
  • ·Recomendador: atuar com papéis de time no desenvolvimento dos perfis de facilitação, provendo conhecimento alinhado com melhores práticas dos papéis

Competências técnicas essenciais

  • ·Técnicas de priorização de backlog de produto – Rice, Moscow, WSJF

Competências comportamentais

  • Proatividade
  • Negociação
  • Influência
  • Comunicação
  • Visão sistêmica
  • Visão analítica
  • Suportar metodológica, comportamental e culturalmente times ágeis, desde o seu nascimento, preparação, ativação e maturação
  • Realizar coach para desenvolvimento de papéis do ecossistema ágil e liderança da companhia, acompanhando a evolução do profissional
  • Realizar mentoria, promovendo a implantação do modelo operacionais de trabalho ágeis, artefatos, ferramentas, acompanhando o uso e prática ágil
  • Realizar consultorias ágeis de design organizacional, constituição de value streams de desenvolvimento e acompanhamento da performance
  • Treinar profissionais do ecossistema ágil, funcionários e colaboradores de consultorias e liderança da companhia
  • Apoiar o ecossistema ágil a gerar valor para o cliente e retorno do investimento
  • Apoiar o ecossistema ágil a ter alta performance e produtividade

Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico - Amil
  • Grupos de idiomas
  • People Mobility: damos uma forcinha para pessoas que tem interesse e disponibilidade de atuar em projetos desafiadores em outros estados e países
  • Ações de treinamento: palestras, fóruns, trocas e conversas de conhecimentos relativos ao nosso negócio. Estamos em constante conexão para aprender mais e juntos
  • Parcerias: temos um grupo no Workplace com descontos de instituições de ensino, escolas de idiomas, academias, restaurantes, produtos e outros serviços
  • Programa +MJVer: programa interno de indicação onde você indica um colega para trabalhar conosco e se esse relacionamento der match, você ganha um prêmio
  • Co-criação: conectamos talentos para gerar soluções completas. Colaboração está no nosso sangue

Vale dados: Step 7: Dados pré-admissionais

A MJV é mais do que uma simples consultoria de tecnologia e inovação . Somos um grupo de mentes diversas, visionárias e determinadas, combinando design, dados e uma mentalidade ágil para oferecer soluções completas, que vão desde a concepção até a implementação de TI.

Nosso legado começou há mais de 25 anos , com o propósito de ajudar empresas a prosperar em suas jornadas de transformação. A MJV é composta por um vasto grupo de pessoas que acreditam no trabalho colaborativo. Aplicamos o Design Thinking , as Metodologias Ágeis e a Sustentabilidade em todos os nossos projetos. A transformação digital também é um dos nossos pilares. Nossa equipe multidisciplinar é formada por designers, engenheiros, publicitários, antropólogos, cientistas de dados, desenvolvedores, empreendedores e muito mais. Também expandimos nossa presença global nas Américas e Europa (Estados Unidos, Inglaterra, França, Itália, Portugal e Colômbia) e abrimos um Laboratório de Inovação na UFRJ (Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro).

Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, inovação e deseja fazer a diferença na vida de outras pessoas, venha fazer parte de um time com mais de 1.400 talentos espalhados pelo mundo para transformar negócios e moldar futuros. Processo de Seleção

Argyle is an established, remote-first startup solving a systemic data problem.

Underneath the consumer finance industry’s decisions and processes is static, analog documentation—things like credit reports and paystubs, designed decades ago for a world that no longer exists. Meanwhile, credit bureaus buy, move, store, and sell consumers’ data without their knowledge or consent.

The result? A labyrinth of manual workflows and shortsighted underwriting models that obstruct financial access, compound operational costs, and impede innovation.

The solution is Argyle. Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus. We are seeking a skilled and driven Senior Application Security Engineer to join Rain's growing Security team. This role demands a proactive approach to secure software development and cloud-native defense. You will partner closely with engineering and development squads, and work alongside our Cloud Security and GRC team members to improve Rain's application and platform security posture. This position is technically grounded, requiring direct engagement in application-layer matters and security reviews, while also contributing to cloud security automation, awareness initiatives, and secure engineering practices across the SDLC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with development squads to validate vulnerabilities and provide actionable remediation guidance aligned with business risk.
  • Drive threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA) for critical systems and APIs.
  • Design, implement, and oversee automated processes for securely updating application and code dependencies, proactively mitigating issues and ensuring timely vulnerability remediation.
  • Integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC), working with tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Trivy, and Burp Suite.
  • Contribute to runtime security initiatives, such as container/Kubernetes hardening, RASP, and eBPF-based detection.
  • Build and maintain a security issues dashboard to track remediation status and metrics.
  • Provide real-time support in the event of cybersecurity incidents impacting applications or cloud infrastructure (exploited vulnerability, credential stuffing, web/API attacks).
  • Partner with the Cloud Security team on security automation tasks and monitoring improvements (e.g., Security Hub remediation automations, DLP monitoring).
  • Conduct proactive research on new threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques relevant to Rain's architecture.
  • Collaborate with the GRC team to develop and deliver internal security awareness initiatives, phishing campaigns, and developer training (e.g., secure coding, API security).
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of AppSec maturity (e.g., aligning with OWASP SAMM, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 frameworks).

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent English, including strong verbal and written skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing roles, and/or secure code development, including work with QA teams.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., Semgrep, Burp, Snyk).
  • Deep understanding of web, mobile, and API vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, MITRE CWE).
  • Proven expertise in performing code reviews or security assessments and writing clear reports.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Node.js) and understanding of React/React Native front-ends.
  • Familiarity with secure architecture of microservices, event-driven systems, and REST APIs using OAuth2/OpenID Connect.
  • Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and integrating AppSec tooling into SDLC.
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes security fundamentals.
  • Understanding of cloud security (preferably AWS), including IAM principles, cloud-native service configurations, and network segmentation.
  • Comfortable with Agile development methodologies and working within cross-functional squads.
  • Software supply chain security (e.g., SBOM, artifact signing).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CPTE, or CSSLP.
  • AWS, GCP, or Azure Security Specialty certification.
  • Familiarity with bug bounty triage and vulnerability management platforms (e.g., DefectDojo).
  • Experience implementing RASP or eBP runtime protection tools.
  • Exposure to LLM/AI security considerations and secure code generation practices.
  • Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana).

title: Payments Systems Analyst
description:
Role Overview

This is a highly specialized, hands-on role focused on credit, debit, and prepaid card issuing and transaction processing. The Payments Systems Analyst will serve as the subject-matter expert in Visa and Mastercard network specifications, ensuring compliance with mandates, cryptographic standards, and operational excellence. The analyst will bridge engineering, product, and operations by maintaining deep technical documentation, building test frameworks, and guiding the company’s adherence to ISO 8583, EMV, PCI DSS, and card brand requirements.

Analysis & Specification

  • Interpret and maintain Visa/Mastercard specifications and internal documentation (fields/DEs, bitmaps, BCD/ASCII/EBCDIC, LLVAR/LLLVAR encodings).
  • Model and review critical ISO 8583 content: DE55 (EMV tags/BER-TLV), DE52 (PIN Data), DE35/45 (Track2/Track1), DE44/48/60/61/63/127, DE39 response codes, etc.
  • Define business rules by MTI and by product (POS, e-commerce, ATM, wallets/tokenization).
  • Align with Visa/Mastercard requirements to avoid operational or financial impacts from non-compliance.

Quality Assurance

  • Create test plans, regression suites, and compliance contracts by card brand.
  • Build and maintain “golden” messages and negative scenarios (field fuzzing, invalid lengths, corrupted data).
  • Automate end-to-end and integration testing with simulators and networks.

Cryptography & Security

  • Validate EMV flows (ARQC/ARPC, IAD, TVR, AIP), 3-D Secure 2.x (ECI, CAVV/UCAF), AVS/CVV2.
  • Monitor HSM/AWS Payment Cryptography (APC) and TR-31/TR-34 processes (when applicable).
  • Ensure PCI DSS compliance and data confidentiality best practices.

Operations & Observability

  • Define and monitor metrics (p95/p99 latency, timeout/reversal rate, approval/denial).
  • Build dashboards/alerts for real-time monitoring.
  • Support incident management, chargeback analysis/tuning, and continuous improvements.

Documentation & Governance

  • Maintain internal specifications aligned with Visa, Mastercard, and other card brand requirements.
  • Disseminate knowledge and train engineering/business teams.
  • Ensure adherence to company and customer certifications.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in card payments (credit, debit, prepaid) with strong exposure to Visa/Mastercard specifications.
  • Hands-on expertise with ISO 8583, EMV, PCI DSS, and card brand mandates.
  • Proven ability to create and validate test suites with simulators/networks.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography and HSM operations in payment environments.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish (Portuguese a plus).
  • Strong cross-functional communication with engineering, product, and operations.
  • Self-starter, detail-oriented, able to balance compliance and operational efficiency.

Advantages

  • Experience with AWS Payment Cryptography, Drata/Vanta, or similar GRC tooling.
  • Prior work in fintech, issuer processor, or card network integrations.
  • Knowledge of ISO 20022 and cross-border payments.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

We\'re looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us.

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

What we offer

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.

Senior Software Development Engineer (Unreal Game)

  • Senior Software Development Engineer (Unreal Game)

As a Senior Software Development Engineer focused on Unreal gameplay programming, you'll continue to grow your expertise in writing high-quality code while learning and using whatever breadth of skills are needed to make a game awesome for players. That may include adding functionality in Unreal Engine, writing gameplay features, or something else entirely. We are prepared to craft the role around the right person, whether you’ve been programming for 4 years or for 20. Teaching others first and maintaining a mentorship culture are key ingredients to our success.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the skills listed here. We understand that your qualifications may shine through in different ways and can be based on unique perspectives and experiences.

Gamebreaking Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity, and are committed to maintaining a safe and inclusive environment for our team.

Desired Skills & Qualifications

  • A passion for games and entertainment that shows. Whether you love video games, board games, cosplay, or freeze tag — we want to know! If it doesn’t shine through your resume (e.g. work, academic, or community experience), please submit a cover letter
  • 5+ years of professional game programming experience
  • Experience working in a large, established code base
  • Deep knowledge of C++ programming and best practices
  • Flexibility and desire to work on a variety of game systems
  • Experience developing with Unreal Engine 4/5 is a plus

Your Responsibilities

  • Write code that is clear, well-tested and modular.
  • Architect and implement features with an eye towards performance and maintainability
  • Assist game teams with technology choices and follow through with implementation.
  • Mentor more junior engineers via paired programming and code reviews.
  • Work with project managers inside and outside our studio to deliver features to players.

Our Responsibilities To You

  • Encourage healthy working hours, PTO, and a respect for your time.
  • Foster an environment of equal opportunity, treatment, and inclusion.
  • Create a fun and playful environment that remains professional and respectful.
  • Grow our culture positively and meaningfully through a high level of transparency and thoughtful conversation.
  • Provide opportunities for you to learn and grow.

Potential Roles and Growth Paths (Choose One)

  • Tech Lead — Lead a tech team through mentorship, setting code standards, and designing and building systems.
  • Engineering Lead — Hire, manage, and mentor a small group of engineers while maintaining client relationships and code familiarity.

  • DIY — A small company means big opportunities if you're willing to forge your path, and we're here to support you!
  • Full Health Benefits — Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • Open PTO
  • Fully Remote Work
  • Annual Company Retreat

About Gamebreaking

Gamebreaking Studios is a young, growing, LA-based company founded by technology leaders from around games, entertainment, and software. We found early success providing work-for-hire to other studios and now build everything from end-to-end games to online game platforms to individual feature integrations. We also develop our own games and IP alongside other projects.

Our mission: We aspire to make games and media so fun that it improves people's relationships and behaviors. That is to say, while we are not a "serious games" company, we believe that making fun-first games enables us to have a positive impact. We believe deeply in our core values and hope to find people who share them:

  • Take Responsibility
  • Raise The Tide, Not One Boat
  • Ambitious Goals, Disciplined Execution
  • Design For People, Own Your Craft
  • We Play Together

L iving and working outside the US at Gamebreaking

This position is open to candidates living and working throughout Latin America (pay varies by location). Outside the US, we work with an Employer of Record (deel.com) to hire full-time employees. This works very similar to how employees would work for a company based in their home country. Nossas pessoas são a essência do nosso sucesso, por isso valorizamos a meritocracia, a autonomia e uma cultura de aprendizado constante.

Venha crescer com a gente!

Missão do cargo:

Estabelecer políticas, estratégias e diretrizes da disciplina de Engenharia de Confiabilidade de Manutenção das instalações e equipamentos por meio da implementação de metodologias de Engenharia de Confiabilidade e dos planos de manutenção preventiva e preditiva a fim de garantir e maximizar a confiabilidade, disponibilidade, manutenção, segurança e integridade dos ativos no ciclo de vida útil, dando atendimento aos objetivos de custos, produtividade, qualidade e segurança, assim como a preservação do meio ambiente de acordo com as políticas da COMPANHIA e conformidade legal aplicável.

Main responsibilities

  1. Dar suporte técnico nas diferentes etapas dos Projetos (Engenharia Conceitual, Básica e Detalhada) para garantir a confiabilidade e disponibilidade das instalações, equipamentos e sistemas inerentes ao Projeto, aplicando metodologias e estudos de Engenharia de Confiabilidade;
  2. Estabelecer as políticas, estratégiase programas de Engenharia de Confiabilidade para otimizar os planos de manutenção preventiva e preditiva, garantindo a confiabilidade de equipamentos e instalações através de uma relação custo-risco-beneficio positiva na gestão de ativos;
  3. Desenvolver e implementar metodologias de análise para determinar a confiabilidade e disponibilidade das instalações, componentes, equipamentos e sistemas;
  4. Realizar análise de problemas operacionais para minimizarfalhas ou paradas não programadas que tem impacto na continuidade operacional, segurança e confiabilidade para atingir os objetivos estabelecidos, alémde suportar a implementação de técnicas de manutenção preditiva, padrões de gestão, análise de falhas, melhorias de projetos e melhores práticas de planejamento e controle de manutenção. Cumprindo com os objetivos de custos, produtividade, qualidade e segurança, assim como a preservação do meio ambiente de acordo com as políticas da Companhia e conformidade legal aplicável;
  5. Suportar tecnicamente na implementação das metodologias de:Análise de Criticidade de Ativos, Confiabilidade, Análise de Disponibilidade e Manutenibilidade, Metodologia para Desenho de Planos de Inspeção Baseados em Riscos, Metodologia para Solução de Problemas Baseada em Análise de Causa Raiz, Estudos de Custo Risco - Benefício, Análise Econômica do Ciclo de Vida dos Ativos, Manutenção Centrada em Confiabilidade, Análises de efeito e modos de falhas, para otimizar as estratégias e planos de inspeção e manutenção;
  6. Elaborar recomendações técnicas ou planos de ação a fim de atender as necessidades da Operação por meio do alinhamento com a gestão técnica e suporte de manutenção;
  7. Realizar avaliações técnicas dos processos de planejamento, programação, inspeção e manutenção por meio de auditorias técnicas para garantir o cumprimento dos planos estabelecido, objetivos da Companhia e obrigações legais aplicáveis. Suportar o planejamento orçamentário anual (despesas e investimentos) para a disciplina sob responsabilidade, fornecendo informações baseadas em experiências anteriores, conhecimento técnico e melhores práticas do mercado;
  8. Participar e / ou elaborar padrões corporativos como parte do Sistema de Gestão Integrado, bemgeração dos relatórios e notas técnicas inerente ao cargo para preservar o conhecimento dentro da Organização contribuindo com os objetivos de qualidade, custo e produção de óleo e gás. Assegurar que as estratégias de manutenção sejam implementadas nas rotinas da frota em conformidade com as diretrizes da Companhia e órgãos reguladores;
  9. Contribuir para a governança do CMMS atualizando e monitorando informações sobre hierarquia, descrição de trabalho, plano de inspeção e manutenção. Monitorar os KPIs das barreiras de segurança de processos e fornecer recomendação técnica, quando necessário, a fim de garantir a eficácia dos processos e manter a operação da instalação dentro do nível ALARP;
  10. Garantir a comunicação e o alinhamento com a equipe nas Operações e apoiar suas necessidades, a fim de alcançar conformidade com os planos de inspeção e manutenção.

  • Formação acadêmica: Engenharia Mecânica, Metalúrgica, de Materiais, Petróleo, Industrial ou áreas correlatas, com mínimo de 7 anos de experiência na especialidade .
  • Experiência em Engenharia de Confiabilidade , incluindo:

Overview


As a FULL STACK DEVELOPER, you will work on multiple projects that may span a broad range of applications as a project team member, sometimes as a project lead. You may require expertise in multiple technical environments and business knowledge that spans one or more business areas.


As a Full Stack Developer, you must be able to adjust to constant business change and as needed to proactively plan for changes that are likely to occur. Common types of changes include introduction of new organizations through mergers and acquisitions, the separation of parts of organization (as subsidiaries, or when the business changes direction), evolving goals and strategies and emerging technologies. These changes require integration of solutions that can impact the overall system development activity. Application Developers also provide client support, consultation and subject matter expertise for system development, maintenance and support.


In this job family you will work closely with clients, business analysts and team members to understand the business requirements that drive the analysis and design of quality technical solutions. These solutions must be aligned with business and IT strategies and are in compliance with the organization’s architectural standards. Application Developers are involved in the full systems life cycle and therefore are responsible for designing, coding, testing, implementing and supporting application software that is delivered on time and within budget. Responsibilities beyond development of software may include participation in component and data architecture design, technology planning, product evaluation, advanced testing processes and buy vs. build recommendations. Individuals also provide input to project plans related to the Application Development initiative.


As a Full Stack Application Developer, you need to have a strong knowledge of programming languages used by the organization.   • DESIGN

  • CODE AND TEST

Integrates solutions with other applications and platforms outside the framework. Creates data extracts and reports from system based requirements. Develops, executes and documents test plans.


  • DEPLOYMENT

  • MAINTENANCE (BREAK/FIX)

    Provides ongoing maintenance of applications. Leads review sessions where patterns of development and break/fix metrics are reviewed as part of standard process for optimizing IT development processes.


  • PRODUCTION SUPPORT

    Provides Level 2 and 3 production support. Troubleshoots existing information systems to identify errors or deficiencies and develops solutions


  • PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT

    Evaluates existing applications and platform and provides recommendations for improving application performance by conducting gap analysis, identifying feasible alternative solutions, and assisting in the scope of modifications. Participates on teams that outline the process and scope out the improvements that can be realized through the application solution.


  • DOCUMENTATION/USER GUIDES

    Documents functions and changes to new or modified modules and test activities/results and other areas such as error handling and backup/recovery procedures. Assists in the development of user guides and training documentation for systems

Helps to define the company’s standard development process (SDLC). title: Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry
description:
Overview

Sweden needs skilled engineers!

About 30 000 of them by 2030 to be precise, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. Right now we have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help us?

Job Description

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are great by any international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to the relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, arrangement of housing, you name it - we fix it!

Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team characterized by a profound joy for having the opportunity to be able to help engineers and their families to build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope's core values are joy, trust, and professionalism!

Required competence

  • At least 5 years of professional experience from recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.
  • A solid and well proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service oriented, with a flexible mindset towards always finding the best solution for the challenge at hand.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and the principle of IT outstaffing/outsourcing companies.
  • Upper intermediate English.
  • Some knowledge of at least a handful of contemporary IT technologies and methods, as well as the ability to learn the main ideas of new technologies.
  • Analytical, well organized with an eye for details, with the ability to identify and close a recruitment request.
  • Self confident, happy, social, friendly and outgoing with a high level of self motivation.
  • Durable and stubborn, with the capacity to take a 'no' as a reason to try harder.
  • Passionate about success, with an executive yet relaxed attitude towards work, colleagues and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible, with an appropriate and representative appearance.

Extent & Duration

Start ASAP. Full time. Long term contract as a Private Entrepreneur. Minimum 12 months. Eight hours of efficient work per day, Monday to Friday. Overtime compensation 1:1 in flex.

Location

You will be working from home or from a co-location center of your choice.

Economy

Remuneration starting at 1200 USD, plus remittance fees and taxes. Free national holidays, with maintained payment. 20 paid vacation days. Paid travels, housing, and per diem.

Application

title: Network Manager
description:
Overview

Who We Are

Ready to create a healthier world? We are ready for you! Personify Health is on a mission to simplify and personalize the health experience to improve health and reduce costs for companies and their people. At Personify Health, we believe in offering total rewards, flexible opportunities, and a diverse inclusive community, where every voice matters. Together, we’re shaping a healthier, more engaged future.

Responsibilities

Ready to Drive Excellence Across Diverse Network Partnerships?

We're seeking a strategic operational leader who can manage the ongoing performance of our diverse portfolio of leased carrier networks while serving as a direct extension of the Director of Network Management. As our Network Manager, you'll ensure internal operational excellence while supporting the strategic success of our network products, including leased networks and COE partners.

What makes this role different

  • Portfolio management: Oversee diverse network partnerships including secondary, regional, and dental networks with comprehensive performance monitoring
  • Strategic insights: Develop performance dashboards that deliver actionable insights driving business decisions for leadership and client account teams
  • Cross-functional impact: Collaborate with Claims Operations, Clinical teams, and Commercial teams to ensure operational alignment and excellence
  • Implementation leadership: Support GTM new network implementation with project management expertise and operational readiness coordination

What You'll Actually Do

  • Drive network performance excellence: Report on network performance focusing on KPIs including performance guarantees, client and membership growth, network revenue, product utilization, and quality outcomes.
  • Maintain operational oversight: Develop network management documentation, prepare internal updates, manage contracts, and serve as primary contact for operational issues and processes.
  • Monitor compliance rigorously: Track performance guarantees for all networks, ensure accurate delivery of network scorecards, and review data for ongoing compliance with membership growth targets and claims timeliness.
  • Resolve complex escalations: Lead research and resolution of service requests including complex client escalations related to network issues while collaborating with networks on training coordination.
  • Support strategic initiatives: Provide GTM new network implementation support, organize network notifications processes, and contribute to strategic development of network management capabilities.
  • Enable internal teams: Support Claims Operations by providing clarity on unique operational and contractual nuances of each network while building collaborative relationships with Commercial and Operations Enablement teams.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Mission

  • The operational foundation:
    • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or related field (equivalent work experience considered)
    • 2-4 years experience in provider network management, provider relations, or healthcare operations
    • Experience within TPA, health plan, or health system environment
  • The analytical expertise:
    • Demonstrated experience with different provider reimbursement models including fee-for-service
    • Understanding of value-based care concepts (ACOs, Clinically Integrated Networks)
    • Proven ability to analyze healthcare data (claims, provider, network, eligibility) to identify trends and solve problems
  • The professional competencies:
    • Relationship building: Natural ability to build rapport and establish trust with clients, providers, and internal colleagues
    • Analytical mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with talent for translating complex data into clear, actionable insights
    • Project management: Outstanding organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities effectively
    • Communication excellence: Exceptional written and verbal skills for presenting information clearly to diverse audiences
    • Autonomy and initiative: Self-starter who can work independently, take ownership of projects, and navigate ambiguity in dynamic environments
    • Technical proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel) with comfort learning new claims and provider management software

Why You'll Love It Here

We believe in total rewards that actually matter—not just competitive packages, but benefits that support how you want to live and work.

Your wellbeing and Benefits

  • Your wellbeing comes first: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build!)
  • Mental health support and wellness programs designed by experts who get it
  • Flexible work arrangements that fit your life, not the other way around
  • Financial security that makes sense: Retirement planning support to help you build real wealth for the future
  • Basic Life and AD&D Insurance plus Short-Term and Long-Term Disability protection
  • Employee savings programs and voluntary benefits like Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity coverage
  • Growth without limits: Professional development opportunities and clear career progression paths
  • Mentorship from industry leaders who want to see you succeed
  • Learning budget to invest in skills that matter to your future

A culture that energizes

  • People Matter: Inclusive community where every voice matters and diverse perspectives drive innovation
  • One Team One Dream: Collaborative environment where we celebrate wins together and support each other through challenges
  • We Deliver: Mission-driven work that creates real impact on people's health and wellbeing, with clear accountability for results
  • Grow Forward: Continuous learning mindset with team events, recognition programs, and celebrations that make work genuinely enjoyable

The practical stuff

  • Competitive base salary plus bonus structure that rewards your success
  • Unlimited PTO policy because rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Benefits effective day one—because you shouldn’t have to wait to be taken care of

Ready to create a healthier world? We're ready for you.

No candidate will meet every single qualification listed. If your experience looks different but you think you can bring value to this role, we'd love to learn more about you.

Personify Health is an equal opportunity organization and is committed to diversity, inclusion, equity, and social justice.

In compliance with all states and cities that require transparency of pay, the base compensation for this position ranges from $100,000 to $120,000. Note that compensation may vary based on location, skills, and experience. This position is eligible for 10% target bonus/variable compensation as well as health, dental, vision, mental health and other benefits.

We strive to cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive. Personify Health is committed to driving Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) for all stakeholders: employees (at each organization level), members, clients and the communities in which we operate. Diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

#WeAreHiring #PersonifyHealth

Beware of Hiring Scams: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information such as social security numbers during the hiring process. All official communication will come from a verified company email address. If you receive suspicious requests or communications, please report them All of our legitimate openings can be found on the Personify HealthCareer Site.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!
